metadata.description: Claude Code plugins to adopt iPhone Duo (foldable) support in Flutter apps.

plugins.name: iphone-duo
plugins.description: An agent and eight step skills that take any Flutter app to full iPhone Duo support: Flutter 3.41+, UIScene, the iOS 27.1 SDK, width-driven layouts, media life cycle (camera, video, maps, audio), hinge detection and hinge avoidance.
